newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil four-month insurance premiums up 20.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil four-month insurance premiums up 20.9 pct.

text.p: Premiums at Brazilian insurance companies grew 20.9 percent to 5.6 billion reais in the first four months of 1997, compared with the same period of last year, said the country's insurance watchdog Susep.
Car, life and health insurance accounted for most of the companies' revenues, it said in a statement.
Sao Paulo state accounted for 49 percent of all premiums, followed by Rio de Janeiro state, with 16 percent, it added.
It also said capitalization revenues totalled 1.9 billion reais in the period.
